`cases.jsonl` has one case per line. Include prompts that should trigger the skill and near-miss prompts that shouldn't:

```json
{"id":"basic","prompt":"<realistic user request>","must_contain":["<string>"],"rubric":"Output does X and does not do Y"}
{"id":"no-trigger","prompt":"<unrelated request>","must_not_contain":["<skill-specific marker>"]}
```

## Runner (`run.sh`)

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
out=evals/my-skill/results; mkdir -p "$out"

# Baseline copy with the skill removed
base=$(mktemp -d); git archive HEAD | tar -x -C "$base"
rm -rf "$base/.claude/skills/my-skill"

while read -r line; do
  id=$(jq -r .id <<<"$line"); p=$(jq -r .prompt <<<"$line")
  claude -p "$p" --output-format json > "$out/$id.with.json"
  (cd "$base" && claude -p "$p" --output-format json) > "$out/$id.without.json"
  # deterministic check
  for s in $(jq -r '.must_contain[]?' <<<"$line"); do
    jq -r .result "$out/$id.with.json" | grep -qF -- "$s" && echo "PASS $id has $s" || echo "FAIL $id missing $s"
  done
done < evals/my-skill/cases.jsonl
```

For rubric cases, add a judge call. Pass it the output and the rubric, and ask for `PASS` or `FAIL` plus a reason: `claude -p "Rubric: ... Output: ... Answer PASS or FAIL then one sentence."`

```bash

echo "evals/*/results/" >> .gitignore
./evals/my-skill/run.sh | tee evals/my-skill/results/summary.txt
```
